2026 Summary of Benefits
UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage Choice Plan 2 (PPO)
H1234-001-000
Snohomish County, Washington

Monthly Plan Premium: $0 per month
Part B Premium Reduction: $50 per month
Maximum out-of-pocket responsibility: $5,900 per year (in-network)

Doctor Visits
Primary care physician visit: $0 copay per visit
Specialist visit: $35 copay per visit
Urgently needed care: $40 copay per visit
Emergency care: $125 copay per visit (waived if admitted within 24 hours)
Outpatient surgery at an outpatient hospital: $300 copay per visit

Comprehensive Dental: $2,500 allowance per year for covered services.
Eyewear: $400 allowance per year toward frames or contact lenses.
Hearing aids: $1,500 allowance per year, up to two devices.

Prescription Drugs
Part D deductible: $615 per year, applies to Tier 3, 4 and 5 only.
Tier 1 Preferred Generic: $0 copay for a 30-day supply at a preferred pharmacy.
Tier 2 Generic: $10 copay for a 30-day supply at a preferred pharmacy.
